children: Overview
New Zealand real estate trust's net property income for H1 FY27 fell 1.1% yr/yr
Net distributable income for H1 FY27 rose 1.3% yr/yr
Company occupancy improved to 98.2%, up from 94.6% at 31 March
Outlook
Argosy reaffirms FY27 full-year dividend guidance at 6.65 cents per share
Company says focus over next 12 months will be addressing vacancies and lease expiries
Argosy continues to target 50% of portfolio as green assets by 2031
Result Drivers
LEASING MOMENTUM - Improved occupancy to 98.2% and longer weighted average lease term driven by new leases and renewals, according to management

DIVESTMENTS AND COST PRESSURES - Net property income declined due to lost income from property sales, prior year surrender fees, and higher Wellington rates, partially offset by rent reviews and development income
GREEN REFINANCING - Post-period refinancing is expected to save NZ$2 mln annually and extend average debt tenor to 3.5 years
